about: A species profile for each tree of trees.json (same order; check n and the trees.json SHA-256), for the crowns, colours and leaf calendar of the Three.js port. Built by tools/build-tree-species.mjs; profiles, taxon rules and setting mixes: docklands/tree-species.js. Basis letters other than S and G are INFERRED, not data.

basis.S: taxon from the source (species or cultivar)
basis.G: genus or family from the source
basis.L: inferred: OSM leaf_type / leaf_cycle with the setting
basis.P: inferred: park or garden mix (no taxon)
basis.W: inferred: wood or tree-group mix (no taxon)

format.p: one letter per tree: index into profiles in base 64 (A-Z a-z 0-9 + /)
format.b: one letter per tree: a key of basis
